dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You can do something like that?

dialogues.speaker: Toltec
dialogues.text: Of course. There are plenty of fields where graffiti can be used. Most people just don't consider them, is all.

dialogues.speaker: Toltec
dialogues.text: Woven scrolls, stone carvings, graffiti — these are all media used to keep records and express oneself. In the hands of someone talented, they can certainly play roles as positive as they are unexpected.
